title: Assets Finding problem
author: _serse
selftext:
I built an IDLE game about grinding into the Esports world.

https://preview.redd.it/0bniez2zqkhh1.png?width=1920&format=png&auto=webp&s=209ae0bd091501ecb767eeee734352f804c0f355

What do you think about it?  
Every feedback is great... it's my first game so I know that there are a lot of things to improve... Let me know!

It was build using Claude Opus 5

As first i setted up the math. Claude Opus 5 and Fable are amazing on this.. their math is just top level math

Even the UI was built by him but... not totally. I ha to go throught a lot of iterations bc of the ppor vision he has. For example: I wanted to implement a gacha system. the math about prices and everything was done by Claude but the animations where... absent! i just prompted how i wanted the effects and everything giving adrenaline for each pull.

The first GUI looked a LOT ai slop, so i had to iterate a lot where the game looked bad.

The game assets are absent bc till now i don't know how to GENERATE them. there are a lot of free assets online but they are all bout medieval/rpg stuffs.

when i included assests it was just shameful bc of the poor vision he as, so it was just pasting random things all around.

My goal now is to improve this game by adding assests for a better experience but using Claude Opus 5 it's still naive.

The game assets, in the end, i don't want them to be generated by LLMs (it's not their purpose) but i'm still looking for websites for free assets or just an AI optimale for this specific use case.

Am i alone in this problems? Which solutions have you found?

Thank you if you read it till the end <3
